88.english_meaning: A system of government by the whole population or all the eligible members of a state, typically through elected representatives.
88.example: India is considered a great experiment in representative democracy.

88.hindi_meaning: आँका गया या अनुमान लगाया गया
88.example: The success of India's election system can be gauged from various factors.

88.english_meaning: In every case or on every occasion; invariably.
88.example: Voters have consistently taken a keen interest in the election process.

88.english_meaning: Fitting in with the wishes or needs of others; helpful and inclusive.
88.hindi_meaning: समावेशी या सबको साथ लेकर चलने वाला
88.example: Our election system has proved to be accommodative and inclusive.

88.english_meaning: Containing a lot of different people or things and treating them fairly and equally.
88.example: An inclusive electoral system represents all sections of society.

88.english_meaning: The nature of something's ingredients or constituents; the way in which a whole or mixture is made up.
88.example: The social composition of our representatives has changed gradually over time.

88.english_meaning: The way a thing turns out; a consequence.
88.example: Electoral malpractices rarely affect the final outcome of the election.

88.english_meaning: Wrongdoing or professional misconduct, especially in public office or elections.
88.example: Strict rules are enforced to prevent electoral malpractices.

88.english_meaning: The fraudulent manipulation of an election or competition.
88.example: The commission takes immediate action against any attempts at rigging.

88.english_meaning: The action of intimidating someone, typically into forcing them to do something.
88.example: Voters should be able to cast their votes without fear of intimidation.

88.english_meaning: The quality or character of being periodic; the tendency to recur at regular intervals.
88.example: The periodicity of elections ensures democracy remains vibrant.

89.english_meaning: The act of speaking or acting on behalf of someone else, especially in a political system.
89.example: Good representation ensures that the voices of all citizens are heard in the parliament.

89.english_meaning: The quality of being accepted as conforming to law, rules, or established principles.
89.example: The legitimacy of the election process is essential for a stable democracy.

89.english_meaning: Clears someone or something of blame or suspicion; proves to be right, reasonable, or justified.
89.example: The success of the election vindicates the foresight of our Constitution makers.

89.english_meaning: Without any blemishes, imperfections, or mistakes; perfect.
89.example: The committee worked hard to make the voting process completely flawless.

89.english_meaning: A period of public festivity; used metaphorically here to describe elections as a grand celebration of democracy.
89.example: General elections in India are often seen as a grand carnival of democracy.

89.english_meaning: A form of democracy in which people decide policy initiatives directly, rather than through representatives.
89.example: Gram Sabha meetings are often cited as an example closest to direct democracy in rural India.

89.english_meaning: A body consisting of all persons registered in the electoral rolls relating to a village panchayat.
89.example: Every registered voter in the village is a member of the Gram Sabha.

89.english_meaning: An official list of people who are eligible to vote in an election.
89.example: Preparing accurate electoral rolls is one of the primary duties of the Election Commission.

89.english_meaning: A small enclosure in which a voter stands alone to mark their ballot confidentially.
89.example: Volunteers helped senior citizens navigate their way to the polling booths.

89.english_meaning: A set of guidelines issued by the Election Commission of India for conduct of political parties and candidates.
89.example: Political parties must strictly follow the model code of conduct once elections are announced.

89.english_meaning: Observing and directing the execution of a task, activity, or process.
89.example: The Election Commission is responsible for supervising free and fair panchayat elections in some states.

89.english_meaning: The upper house of the Parliament of India.
89.example: Members of the Rajya Sabha are elected indirectly by the elected members of state legislative assemblies.

89.english_meaning: The lower house of the Parliament of India, directly elected by the people.
89.example: Citizens above the age of 18 participate in electing members to the Lok Sabha.

89.english_meaning: Having the right to do or obtain something through satisfying the appropriate conditions.
89.example: Every Indian citizen aged 18 or above is eligible to vote.

89.english_meaning: An electoral system where the candidate with the most votes wins, even if they do not achieve an absolute majority.
89.hindi_meaning: सर्वाधिक मत पाने वाले की जीत की प्रणाली (FPTP)
89.example: India follows the First Past the Post system for Lok Sabha and state assembly elections.

90.english_meaning: A body of voters in a specified area who elect a representative to a legislative body
90.example: She is contesting the election from a rural constituency.

90.english_meaning: All the people in a country or area who are entitled to vote in an election
90.example: The separate electorate system was rejected by the makers of the Indian Constitution.

90.english_meaning: Required by law or rules; compulsory
90.example: Wearing a seatbelt while driving is mandatory.

90.english_meaning: Unfavorable circumstances, especially with regard to financial or social opportunities
90.example: The electoral system aims at ensuring representation of socially disadvantaged sections.
The government passed new legislation to protect the environment.

90.english_meaning: Required or expected to justify actions or decisions; responsible
90.example: Elected leaders must be accountable to the people who voted for them.
India is a diverse country with many linguistic minorities.

90.english_meaning: A lack of compatibility or similarity between two or more facts
90.example: There should be no discrepancy between votes and seats won by different parties.

90.english_meaning: Free from outside control; not subject to another's authority
90.example: The Election Commission of India functions as an independent body.

90.english_meaning: Observe and direct the execution of a task or activity
90.example: Teachers supervise the students during the examination.

90.english_meaning: Corresponding in size or amount to something else
90.example: Proportional representation ensures seats are won in proportion to votes received.

90.english_meaning: A person or thing acting or serving in place of another
90.example: Identify the incorrect statement and correct it by substituting a word.

90.english_meaning: The action of speaking or acting on behalf of someone
90.example: Fair representation of all communities strengthens democracy.

90.english_meaning: Engage in competition to win something
90.example: Many candidates registered to contest the upcoming election.

90.english_meaning: The legislative body of a country or state
90.example: The legislature is responsible for making and amending laws.

91.english_meaning: The quality of treating all people and groups equally without bias or favoritism.
91.example: The Election Commission must maintain strict impartiality during elections.

91.english_meaning: An electoral system in which parties gain seats in proportion to the total number of votes cast for them.
91.example: Proportional representation ensures that smaller parties receive a fair share of legislative seats.

91.english_meaning: Done or acting according to a fixed plan or system; methodical.
91.example: The SVEEP programme is a systematic initiative to educate voters.

91.english_meaning: The action of taking part in something, such as an event or activity.
91.example: High voter participation is essential for a healthy democracy.
Electoral reforms are necessary to make the voting process more transparent.

91.english_meaning: (Of a feeling or memory) lasting a long time; enduring.
91.example: Citizens of India have an abiding faith in democratic values.
Students took a pledge to vote fearlessly in every election.

91.english_meaning: To support or defend a custom, rule, or principle.
91.example: We must uphold the democratic traditions of our country.

91.english_meaning: The state or quality of being worthy of honor or respect.
91.example: Free and fair elections protect the dignity of citizens.

91.english_meaning: Affected or swayed by someone or something.
91.example: Citizens should vote without being influenced by caste or religion.

91.english_meaning: A thing that persuades or influences someone to do something, often a bribe or incentive.
91.example: Voters should reject any monetary inducement during elections.

91.english_meaning: A factor to be kept in mind when making a decision.
91.example: Voting should be free from considerations of language and community.

91.english_meaning: A system of government by the whole population, typically through elected representatives.
91.example: Indian democracy relies heavily on active civic engagement.

91.english_meaning: Competence or knowledge in a specified area.
91.example: Electoral Literacy Clubs help young citizens understand the voting process.

91.english_meaning: To take part in an election or try to win control of something.
91.example: Former Election Commissioners should not be allowed to contest elections.

92.english_meaning: The branch of government responsible for implementing laws and running the administration.
92.example: The executive is one of the three main organs of the government.

92.english_meaning: The legislative body of a country, responsible for making laws.
92.example: The legislature has the power to pass new laws.

92.english_meaning: The judicial authorities and system of courts in a country.
92.example: An independent judiciary is essential for a democracy.

92.english_meaning: The organization of different elements to work effectively together.
92.example: The three organs of government work in coordination with each other.

92.english_meaning: Relating to, enacted by, or suitable for a parliament.
92.example: India has a parliamentary system of government.

92.english_meaning: Dependent on each other; mutually dependent.
92.example: In a parliamentary system, the executive and the legislature are interdependent.

92.english_meaning: The nature of something's ingredients or constituents; the way in which a whole is made up.
92.example: We studied the composition and structure of the executive.

92.english_meaning: Relating to a president or a presidency, especially a system where the president is head of government.
92.example: The USA follows a presidential system of government.

92.english_meaning: Allowed by or contained in a constitution.
92.example: We need to understand the constitutional position of the President.

92.english_meaning: An advisory, deliberative, or administrative body of people formally constituted.
92.example: The Council of Ministers aids and advises the Prime Minister.

92.english_meaning: Relating to the running of a business, organization, or nation.
92.example: The administrative machinery helps implement government policies.

92.english_meaning: An organized system or set of procedures for operating something.
92.example: The administrative machinery is vital for the state.

92.english_meaning: The health, happiness, and fortunes of a person or group.
92.example: Governments work to look after the welfare of the people.

92.english_meaning: A difference or contrast between similar things or people.
92.example: Students must make a distinction between the parliamentary and presidential systems.

92.english_meaning: The way in which something works or operates.
92.example: We discussed the functioning of the Council of Ministers.

93.english: The branch of government responsible for the implementation of laws and policies.
93.hindi: कार्यपालिका (सरकार का वह अंग जो कानूनों और नीतियों को लागू करने के लिए उत्तरदायी है)
93.example: The executive is responsible for enforcing the laws passed by the legislature.

93.english: The process or activity of running a business, organization, or government.
93.hindi: प्रशासन (किसी संस्था या सरकार को चलाने की व्यवस्था या कार्य)
93.example: Good administration is essential for the smooth running of any school.

93.english: To put a decision, plan, agreement, etc., into effect.
93.hindi: लागू करना (किसी निर्णय या योजना को अमल में लाना)
93.example: The government decided to implement the new education policy immediately.

93.english: To observe and direct the execution of a task or activity.
93.example: Teachers supervise the students during the school examination.

93.english: To bring the different elements of a complex activity or organization into a harmonious relationship.
93.hindi: समन्वय करना (विभिन्न गतिविधियों में तालमेल बिठाना)
93.example: All departments must coordinate with each other to achieve the goal.

93.english: A course or principle of action adopted or proposed by a government, party, business, or individual.
93.hindi: नीति (सरकार या संस्था द्वारा तय किया गया कार्य-सिद्धान्त)
93.example: The ruling party announced a new economic policy for the country.

93.english: The legislative body of a country or state, responsible for making laws.
93.example: The legislature passed the crucial amendment bill yesterday.

93.english: An organized system or set of procedures for operating something.
93.example: The administrative machinery of the state works round the clock.

93.english: Members of a service in which employees are appointed by a non-political process to government departments.
93.example: Civil servants play a vital role in executing government policies.

93.english: The leaders elected by the people who hold the overall responsibility of government policy.
93.hindi: राजनीतिक कार्यपालिका (जनता द्वारा चुने गए नेता जो नीतियों के लिए उत्तरदायी होते हैं)
93.example: Ministers form a part of the political executive in a democracy.

93.english: The civil servants who remain in office even when the government changes, responsible for day-to-day administration.
93.hindi: स्थाई कार्यपालिका (स्थाई प्रशासनिक अधिकारी जो रोजमर्रा का प्रशासन संभालते हैं)
93.example: The permanent executive assists ministers in running the government.

93.english: Required or expected to justify actions or decisions; responsible.
93.example: In a democracy, the government is accountable to the people.

93.english: Performed as part of a regular procedure rather than for a special reason.
93.example: He handles all routine administrative tasks in the morning.

93.english: A senior state or political official, often the head of government in some countries like Germany.
93.hindi: चांसलर (कुछ देशों में सरकार का प्रमुख या उच्च प्रशासनिक पद)
93.example: The Chancellor addressed the nation regarding the new budget.

94.english: The branch of government responsible for implementing laws and running the administration.
94.example: The executive branch of the government is responsible for enforcing laws.

94.english: A system of government where the president is both the head of state and head of government.
94.example: The United States operates under a presidential system.

94.english: A system of government where the ministers of the executive branch are drawn from the legislature.
94.example: India and the UK both follow a parliamentary system of government.

94.english: A system of government in which a monarch shares power with a constitutionally organized government.
94.example: Canada has a parliamentary democracy with a constitutional monarchy.

94.english: A system in which a president exists alongside a prime minister and cabinet, with power shared between them.
94.example: France and Russia both have a semi-presidential system.

94.english: The chief public representative of a country who may hold ceremonial or real executive powers.
94.example: The President is the ceremonial head of state in Germany.

94.english: The person who runs the actual administration and day-to-day government operations, usually a prime minister or chancellor.
94.example: The prime minister acts as the head of government.

94.english: To obtain or get something with care or effort.
94.example: Students were asked to procure a photograph of the SAARC summit.

94.english: To give a brief summary or general explanation of something.
94.example: The teacher decided to outline the nature of the executive system.

94.english: Done in accordance with rules, conventions, or official procedure, often holding nominal rather than real power.
94.example: Queen Elizabeth II is the formal chief of state in Canada.

94.english: To assign a job or role to someone officially.
94.example: The president has the authority to appoint the prime minister.

94.english: To officially remove someone from their job or position.
94.example: The president cannot dismiss ministers if they are responsible to the parliament.

94.english: Answerable or accountable to someone or for something.
94.example: Ministers remain politically responsible to the parliament.

94.english: Serving as a symbol of authority without having actual ruling power.
94.hindi_meaning: औपचारिक या नाममात्र का (केवल समारोहों से संबंधित)
94.example: Germany's president acts as a ceremonial head of state.

94.english: The title of the head of government in certain European countries like Germany.
94.example: The chancellor is the head of government in Germany.

96.english_meaning: A system of government in which a president exists along with a prime minister and cabinet, with both sharing executive powers.
96.hindi_meaning: अर्ध-राष्ट्रपती (ऐसी शासन प्रणाली जिसमें राष्ट्रपति और प्रधानमंत्री दोनों के पास कार्यकारी शक्तियां होती हैं)
96.example: France and Sri Lanka operate under a semi-presidential system.

96.english_meaning: A system where the president holds real executive power and is the active head of government, rather than just a ceremonial figure.
96.hindi_meaning: कार्यकारी राष्ट्रपति प्रणाली (वह व्यवस्था जिसमें वास्तविक कार्यकारी शक्तियां राष्ट्रपति के पास होती हैं)
96.example: The constitution of Sri Lanka introduced the system of Executive Presidency in 1978.

96.english_meaning: Made minor changes to a text, law, or document in order to make it fairer or more accurate.
96.example: The constitution of Sri Lanka was amended in 1978.

96.english_meaning: The supreme commander of a country's armed forces, usually the head of state.
96.example: The President is the Commander-in-Chief of the Armed Forces.

96.english_meaning: A formal expression of opinion or intention voted on by an official body like a parliament.
96.example: The President cannot be removed except by a resolution passed in the parliament.

96.english_meaning: A claim or assertion that someone has done something illegal or wrong, typically one made without proof.
96.example: The Speaker must be satisfied that such allegations merit inquiry.

96.english_meaning: The process by which a legislative body levels charges against a government official for misconduct.
96.example: Compare the role of the Supreme Court in the impeachment of the President.

96.english_meaning: Existing in name only, with no real power or authority.
96.example: Most parliamentary systems have a president who is the nominal head of state.

96.english_meaning: Serving merely as a tradition or formality, without real authority.
96.example: In such a system, the role of the president is primarily ceremonial.

96.english_meaning: A body of high-ranking state officials, consisting of the top ministers of the government.
96.example: The prime minister along with the cabinet wields effective power.

96.english_meaning: To hold and use power, authority, or influence.
96.hindi_meaning: इस्तेमाल करना / धारण करना (शक्ति या अधिकार)
96.example: The prime minister along with the cabinet wields effective power.

96.english_meaning: To have, own, or hold power or qualities.
96.example: The president may possess significant day-to-day powers.

96.english_meaning: A system of democratic governance of a state where the executive derives its democratic legitimacy from its ability to command the confidence of the legislature.
96.example: In a parliamentary system, the prime minister is the head of government.

96.english_meaning: Disapproving of and attempting to prevent something, or being in a contrary position.
96.example: Sometimes the president and the prime minister may belong to different parties and be opposed to each other.

97.english: The branch of government responsible for putting laws into practice and running the administration.
97.hindi_meaning: कार्यपालिका (सरकार का वह अंग जो कानूनों को लागू करता है और शासन चलाता है)
97.example: The executive branch of the government is responsible for implementing laws.

97.english: Relating to, enacted by, or suitable for a parliament.
97.hindi_meaning: संसदीय (संसद से संबंधित या उसके द्वारा संचालित)
97.example: India follows a parliamentary system of government.

97.hindi_meaning: संविधान (मौलिक कानूनों और सिद्धांतों का एक दस्तावेज जिसके अनुसार देश चलाया जाता है)
97.example: The Constitution of India guarantees fundamental rights to its citizens.

97.english: Required or expected to justify actions or decisions; responsible.
97.hindi_meaning: उत्तरदायी / जवाबदेह (अपने कार्यों या निर्णयों के प्रति जिम्मेदार)
97.example: Ministers are accountable to the parliament for their departments.

97.english: One of two or more available possibilities.
97.hindi_meaning: विकल्प (दो या दो से अधिक संभावनाओं में से एक)
97.example: The presidential system was considered as an alternative to the parliamentary system.

97.english: Relating to a president or a system of government where the president is the chief executive.
97.hindi_meaning: राष्ट्रपतीलीय / अध्यक्षीय (राष्ट्रपति से संबंधित शासन प्रणाली)
97.example: The United States has a presidential form of government.

97.hindi_meaning: व्यक्ति-पूजा / व्यक्ति केंद्रित महिमामंडन (किसी एक नेता के प्रति अत्यधिक अंधभक्ति या प्रशंसा)
97.example: The makers of the constitution wanted to prevent the rise of a personality cult.

97.english: Measures taken to protect someone or something or to prevent something undesirable.
97.hindi_meaning: सुरक्षा उपाय / संरक्षा (किसी अनिष्ट को रोकने के लिए किए गए उपाय)
97.example: There must be proper safeguards in the constitution to protect democracy.

97.english: A system of parts working together in a machine or a process to achieve a particular result.
97.hindi_meaning: तंत्र / प्रणाली (किसी उद्देश्य को प्राप्त करने की कार्यप्रणाली या व्यवस्था)
97.example: Various mechanisms are built into the system to check executive power.

97.english: The legislative body of a country or state, responsible for making laws.
97.hindi_meaning: विधायिका (कानून बनाने वाली संस्था, जैसे संसद)
97.example: The executive is answerable to the legislature in a parliamentary system.

97.english: People chosen or elected to speak or act on behalf of others.
97.hindi_meaning: प्रतिनिधि (जनता द्वारा चुने गए व्यक्ति जो उनकी ओर से कार्य करते हैं)
97.example: Members of Parliament are the representatives of the people.

97.example: India adopted the parliamentary system of government after independence.

97.english: Done in accordance with rules, conventions, or etiquette; official.
97.hindi_meaning: औपचारिक / संवैधानिक (कानूनी या आधिकारिक रूप से नाममात्र का)
97.example: The President is the formal Head of the State in India.

97.english: Keeping careful watch for possible danger or difficulties.
97.hindi_meaning: सतर्क / जागरूक (खतरों या लापरवाहियों के प्रति सावधान)
97.example: Citizens must remain vigilant to protect their democratic rights.

97.english: Quick to detect or respond to slight changes, signals, or people's feelings and needs.
97.hindi_meaning: संवेदनशील (जनता की उम्मीदों और जरूरतों के प्रति जागरूक)
97.example: A democratic government should be sensitive to public expectations.

98.english_meaning: The branch of government responsible for putting laws and policies into effect.
98.hindi_meaning: कार्यपालिका (सरकार का वह अंग जो कानूनों को लागू करता है)
98.example: The executive branch of the government is responsible for implementing laws.

98.english_meaning: To grant or give power, authority, or property to someone legally.
98.example: The Constitution vests executive power in the President.

98.english_meaning: Not in a direct manner; through intermediaries rather than directly by citizens.

98.english_meaning: An electoral system in which parties gain seats in proportion to the number of votes cast for them.
98.example: The presidential election follows the system of proportional representation.

98.english_meaning: A charge of misconduct made against the holder of a public office.
98.hindi_meaning: महाभियोग (पद से हटाने की संवैधानिक प्रक्रिया)
98.example: The President can be removed from office through impeachment.

98.english_meaning: The action of breaking or failing to comply with a law or rule.
98.example: Violation of the Constitution is the only ground for the President's impeachment.

98.english_meaning: To assist and provide formal counsel to someone in authority, such as the President.
98.example: The Council of Ministers exists to aid and advise the President.

98.english_meaning: Obligatory; having legal force so that it must be obeyed.

98.english_meaning: Disagreement, typically when public, prolonged, and heated.

98.english_meaning: A minor change or addition designed to improve a text or law, such as a constitution.

98.english_meaning: To consider a decision again, especially with a view to changing it.

98.english_meaning: The governing body of a cabinet consisting of ministers headed by the Prime Minister.
98.example: The Council of Ministers aids and advises the Prime Minister and the President.

98.english_meaning: A voting system designed to achieve proportional representation through ranked voting.
98.example: The President is elected using the single transferable vote method.

98.english_meaning: In accordance with official rules, conventions, or legal requirements.
98.example: Executive power is formally vested in the President.

99.en_meaning: The branch of government responsible for implementing and enforcing laws.
99.example: The executive branch is responsible for running the administration of the country.

99.en_meaning: Done in accordance with rules or convention; official, often without real power.
99.example: The President is the formal head of the government.

99.en_meaning: Having the power to make laws.
99.example: The Parliament holds the primary legislative powers in the country.

99.en_meaning: Connected with a court of law or the administration of justice.
99.example: The Supreme Court exercises judicial powers.

176.english_meaning: Combined or coordinated to function together as a single, unified system.

255.example: The state will recognize the rights of various religious groups.

256.english_meaning: The policy or practice of acquiring full or partial political control over another country, occupying it with settlers, and exploiting it economically.
256.hindi_meaning: औपनिवेशिकवाद (वह प्रणाली जिसमें कोई शक्तिशाली देश किसी अन्य क्षेत्र पर अधिकार करके उस पर अपना नियंत्रण स्थापित करता है)
256.example: India fought against the oppressive system of British colonialism to gain freedom.

256.english_meaning: A fundamental truth or proposition that serves as the foundation for a system of belief or behaviour or for a chain of reasoning.
256.example: Our nation's foreign policy is based on the principle of peaceful coexistence.

256.english_meaning: Not typical or not truly showing the views, interests, or composition of a group of people.
256.hindi_meaning: अप्रतिनिधि (जो जनता की सही या पूरी नुमाइंदगी न करता हो)
256.example: Critics sometimes argue that certain nominated bodies can be unrepresentative of the public will.

256.english_meaning: A restrictive condition; a rule, condition, or fact which prevents something from being as good as it might be.
256.hindi_meaning: सीमा या बाध्यता (कोई कमी या प्रतिबंध)
256.example: Every legal system has its own limitations that lawmakers try to improve over time.

256.english_meaning: To a satisfactory or acceptable extent; enough.
256.hindi_meaning: पर्याप्त रूप से या ठीक प्रकार से
256.example: The current laws fail to adequately protect vulnerable consumers from digital fraud.

256.english_meaning: The ending of inequalities between women and men that are rooted in gender roles, relations, and power.
256.hindi_meaning: लैंगिक न्याय (स्त्री और पुरुष दोनों के लिए समान अधिकार और न्याय)
256.example: Achieving gender justice is essential for the overall development of a democratic society.

256.english_meaning: Provide evidence to support or prove the truth of something.
256.hindi_meaning: पुष्टि करना या प्रमाणित करना (तथ्यों द्वारा सिद्ध करना)
256.example: You need to provide clear data to substantiate your claim about economic growth.

256.english_meaning: A clause in a legal document, a law, etc., providing for a particular matter; a stipulation.
256.example: The constitution has special provisions to protect the rights of minority communities.

256.english_meaning: Setting right an undesirable or unfair situation; curing or relieving a problem.
256.example: The government is taking steps for remedying the shortage of clean drinking water.

256.english_meaning: Relating to or concerned with the interaction of social and economic factors.
256.hindi_meaning: सामाजिक-आर्थिक (जो समाज और अर्थव्यवस्था दोनों से जुड़ा हो)
256.example: Poverty alleviation programs aim to improve the socio-economic status of backward classes.

256.english_meaning: Consigned or lowered to a lower position, rank, or status.
256.hindi_meaning: निम्न स्थान पर रखना या पीछे धकेल देना
256.example: Important matters should not be relegated to a secondary priority.

256.english_meaning: Guidelines enumerated in Part IV of the Indian Constitution for the framing of laws by the government.
256.hindi_meaning: नीति निर्देशक तत्व (संविधान द्वारा सरकार को दिए गए नीतिगत निर्देश)
256.example: Directive Principles aim to establish a welfare state in India.

256.english_meaning: Necessary to make a whole complete; essential or fundamental.
256.example: Moral education is an integral part of school curriculum.

256.english_meaning: A person who organizes the different parts of an activity or the working of an organization.
256.hindi_meaning: समन्वयक (विभिन्न कार्यों या विभागों का प्रबंधन करने वाला व्यक्ति)
256.example: The academic coordinator oversaw the publication of the new textbook.

256.english_meaning: Information about reactions to a product, a person's performance of a task, etc., which is used as a basis for improvement.
256.example: Teachers welcomed constructive feedback from students on the teaching method.
